continuity: Jin Taekyung sustained a slight Internal Injury in his clash with Lee Jungryong but remained standing after Lee withdrew with Park Jihoon.
Taekyung intends to surpass Lee Jungryong and believes both he and the Peace Guild will eventually exceed Lee's expectations.
Team Leader Choi approved Taekyung's attack on Myeongdong Guild, promised to accept responsibility for the outcome, and reaffirmed that he trusts Taekyung deeply.
Lee Jungryong's apparent panic over Park Jihoon's injuries was entirely performative; he used the confrontation to assess Taekyung's ruthlessness and the response of Park Tae Seop.

Park Tae Seop has been bound to Lee Jungryong for roughly twenty years after seeking help during a severe financial crisis and promising to do anything in return; he has committed numerous crimes for Lee.
Lee Jungryong's forces incapacitated approximately one hundred Myeongdong Guild members with sleep magic and concealed the battle beneath a two-hundred-meter illusion.
Lee Jungryong ordered his A-rank mages to alter the memories of dangerous witnesses and ordered that Park Jihoon receive only minimal treatment before being abandoned.
Team Leader Seok is Go Jun, Lee Jungryong's prized Disciple and right-hand man, personally selected and trained by Lee; Lee ordered him to monitor Jin Taekyung and deal with him if necessary.
Lee Jungryong recognized that Taekyung's heat, strength, and mana control were far beyond what his recent F-rank history would suggest, but the source of that power remains unstated.
plot: After Lee Jungryong withdraws with the mutilated Park Jihoon, Jin Taekyung reflects that he took three steps back in their clash but intends to surpass Lee. He credits the confrontation with securing revenge and tacit promises of apology and compensation for Im Kkeokjeong, while giving the Peace Guild an opportunity to grow. Team Leader Choi had approved Taekyung's retaliation and promised to take responsibility for any result, reaffirming that he trusts Taekyung deeply.

Lee Jungryong brings Park Tae Seop to a hall occupied by his own forces, revealing that his anguished concern for Jihoon was an act. He reminds Park of the financial crisis twenty years earlier when Park begged for help, and of Park's promise to do anything in return. Park has since committed numerous crimes for Lee and remains bound by that debt. Lee assures him that the Myeongdong Guild members will live, but his threat remains clear.

Lee's forces use sleep magic to incapacitate roughly a hundred Myeongdong Guild members and cover the surrounding area with a two-hundred-meter illusion so the public will not notice the battle. Lee orders dangerous witnesses to have their memories altered and commands that Jihoon receive only enough treatment to be abandoned somewhere. He orders Team Leader Seok, whose personal name is Go Jun and who is Lee's prized Disciple and right-hand man, to watch Taekyung closely. Lee privately recognizes that Taekyung is no ordinary opponent and questions whether Go Jun is truly stronger than him.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung defeated the immediate operation's attackers and forced Lee Jungryong to withdraw with Park Jihoon, though Taekyung sustained a slight Internal Injury.
Taekyung secured revenge and tacit promises of apology and compensation for Im Kkeokjeong, creating an opportunity for the Peace Guild to grow.
Team Leader Choi endorsed Taekyung's retaliation, intends to make the Peace Guild the world's greatest Guild, and accepts responsibility for the outcome.
Lee Jungryong's apparent concern for Jihoon was an act; he is calculating, ruthless, and willing to erase witnesses.
Park Tae Seop has been indebted to Lee Jungryong for roughly twenty years and committed crimes for him after receiving help during a financial crisis.
Lee's forces concealed the battle with sleep magic, illusion magic, and planned memory tampering.
Go Jun, also known as Team Leader Seok, is Lee Jungryong's prized Disciple and right-hand man.
Lee Jungryong ordered Go Jun to monitor Taekyung and personally intervene if Taekyung becomes a problem.
Lee Jungryong considers Taekyung an unusually dangerous opponent but has not stated what caused Taekyung's sudden growth.
Park Jihoon's eventual survival and recovery after Lee's order for minimal treatment remain unknown.
open_questions: What source or explanation does Lee Jungryong suspect for Taekyung's sudden growth and mana control?
Is Go Jun truly stronger than Jin Taekyung?
What will happen to Park Jihoon after Lee orders him treated only minimally and abandoned?
How will Park Tae Seop respond to Lee Jungryong's renewed threat and his own long-standing criminal obligation?
Is Lee Jungryong the unidentified 'that person,' and is Ares Guild directly behind the broader Black Hunter operation?
What happened to Team 11 after contact was lost?
What exact wrongdoing did Jung Hyunwoo uncover before Park Jihoon killed him?
Who authorized the Black Hunters to target the Peace Guild's D-rank Hunter?
